standard_prerequisites.name: Sheafification commutes with tensor products of presheaves of modules
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Stacks Project, Modules on Sites, Lemma lemma-sheafification-tensor (tag 09BF)
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the tensor products of the sheafifications with sheafifications of presheaf tensor products, enabling the reduction.

core_obligations: Reduce the flatness claim to injectivity of G tensor_{O^#} F^# -> G' tensor_{O^#} F^# for an inclusion G subset G' of modules (proof lines 4536-4540).
Identify both sides with the sheafifications of the corresponding presheaf tensor products, using the compatibility of sheafification with tensor products (proof lines 4541-4545).

On an object U where F(U) is flat over O(U), compute the presheaf tensor product sectionwise to obtain injectivity there, and reduce the problem to a statement about a map of presheaves, which is settled by the covering hypothesis, up to line 4556 (proof lines 4546-4556).
proof_roadmap: Pass from sheaves to presheaves using compatibility of sheafification with tensor products.
Use the flatness hypothesis objectwise to get sectionwise injectivity.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a presheaf of modules whose values admit a covering on which they are flat over the corresponding rings has a flat sheafification. The proof starts from an inclusion of modules and has to prove injectivity of the induced map on tensor products with the sheafification; using that both sides are sheafifications of the presheaf tensor products, and that the presheaf tensor product is computed sectionwise on objects where the module is flat, it reduces the claim to a statement about maps of presheaves which is then handled by the same covering argument (proof lines 4536-4556). H2: the reduction from sheaves to presheaves through the sheafified tensor product, together with the sectionwise flatness test, is the substance.
